verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad API surface (accounting, budgets, webhooks, team/users/cards/locations) covering many core financial-ops functions seen in the UI, and even has an MCP server, suggesting substantial API-UI parity. However, there is no explicit vendor claim of full feature parity, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s across standard paths), making it hard to verify complete coverage of every UI action. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, comprehensive API reference/spec confirming all UI actions are exposed, and independent confirmation from developers that nothing requires the UI.
